results.request: Explain the company's report export policy

plan.explanation: The company allows report exports only to the internal‑reports workspace (DATA-002). By default, reports may include the minimal fields ticket_id, category, status, and resolution_hours (DATA-003). Adding any private customer fields—customer_name, email, phone, or address—requires explicit approval from an authenticated manager for those exact fields and destination. External export destinations are prohibited under all circumstances, even with manager approval (DATA-002). All export actions must specify the fields array explicitly; an empty array is invalid. The relevant policies are SUP-001 (workspace access), DATA-002 (approved destination), DATA-003 (data minimization), and AUTH-004 (exact‑action approval).
